verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented account quotas or per-account instance limits, and no defined process for requesting increases. What exists is adjacent only: API rate limits (1 req/s, launch limited per 12s), 1-Click Cluster size ranges (16–512 GPUs), and a sales 'contact us for reserved capacity' line. None of these is a quota-visibility or quota-raise mechanism.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can see documented quotas and instance limits and raise them through a defined process
